_comment: SHA-256 pins for the ffmpeg/ffprobe sidecars bundled by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs, keyed by <name>-<rust host triple>. A mismatch hard-fails the fetch; a missing key logs the computed hash with pin instructions. mac pins computed+shasum-verified on the owner's machine (2026-08-04); windows pins taken from the v0.8.0 release run's fetch log (run 30937244151) — the exact bytes that shipped in the published installer. Linux CI intentionally unpinned (binaries never ship from CI).
